lines.text: A made-up star rule, a chain of four fractions, and one sneaky trap!
lines.caption: A made-up star rule, a chain of four fractions, and one sneaky trap!

lines.text: Star means a plus b, over one plus a times b.
lines.caption: Star means a plus b, over one plus a times b.

lines.text: What's the value of the whole chain?
lines.caption: What's the value of the whole chain?

lines.text: The trick: score each number as one plus it, over one minus it.
lines.caption: The trick: score each number as one plus it, over one minus it.

lines.text: Our four numbers score three, two, five over three, and three over two.
lines.caption: Our four numbers score three, two, five over three, and three over two.

lines.text: The magic: star two numbers, and their scores multiply!
lines.caption: The magic: star two numbers, and their scores multiply!

lines.text: Multiply the four scores, and you get fifteen.
lines.caption: Multiply the four scores, and you get fifteen.

lines.text: Turn fifteen back, and the answer is seven over eight!
lines.caption: Turn fifteen back, and the answer is seven over eight!

lines.text: Five over seven is only step one.
lines.caption: Five over seven is only step one.

lines.text: Why do scores multiply? The full lesson shows both ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Why do scores multiply? The full lesson shows both ways, plus every trap.
